ledger.note: 1322: the kingdom of Bacan is established. 'According to the Dutch writer Francois Valentijn (1724), the Bacan kingdom was established in 1322' (infobox 'Founded 1322?'). One of the four kingdoms of Maluku, 'tended to be overshadowed by Ternate'.

notes: Cliopatria has no row for Bacan. Wikidata id not looked up (wikidata.org unreachable): null. The end year 1889 is the researcher's choice (the sultan's line ended in 1889 and a commission governed): the page's infobox dates the Dutch vassalisation to 1609 and the sultan's role to 1965, so the 1609-1889 span is a vassal state, whose tint belongs to the dutch-republic and dutch-east-indies dossiers. The Raja Ampat legend and Gebe are not dated on the page. The Tidore dossier uses this slug as counterpart of Nuku's occupation. Gazetteer: Labuha, Bacan, Obi are not in places/regions.
